TAL_FENCING_BIND_WEAPON.why: When you win a Disarm (the target fails a weapon's Disarm save) you may bind its weapon (or attacking limb) to yours instead of knocking it away: the engine's Grapple (escape DC = your Cultivation Save DC, the binding weapon's reach), the bound weapon cannot attack, your binding weapon cannot attack, the bound creature may let go of the weapon for free; all of it ends when the grapple ends or you are Incapacitated (combat/ext/needle_bind.py).

TAL_FENCING_MERIDIAN_SEALING_BIND.why: When a creature fails to escape your Bind Weapon, choose one effect until the bind ends (replacing the last): it cannot take Reactions; Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you; each foot of its movement costs 1 extra foot (combat/ext/needle_bind.py).

TAL_FENCING_TRAITOROUS_BLADE.why: When you win a Disarm the weapon goes into your hand instead of the ground (held_by, as Take a dropped weapon); with your Bonus Action left you may attack with it at once (combat/ext/needle_bind.py).

TAL_FENCING_VACUUM_CUT.why: Each melee weapon attack of the Attack action gets a "Vacuum Cut" variant: expend Martial Focus, reach 30 feet for the first strike of that Attack action (the later strikes keep the weapon's reach), offered against a creature beyond the weapon's own reach; still a melee weapon attack (Exploits, Mastery, cover, sight) (combat/ext/needle_vacuum.py).

TAL_FENCING_NO_SPACE_BETWEEN_THOUGHT_AND.why: Vacuum Cut's reach is 60 feet (combat/ext/needle_vacuum.py); the second draw needs nothing at the table, because drawing a weapon already costs no Action and can be done any number of times.

TAL_FENCING_VACUUM_SLICE.why: A "Vacuum Slice" variant of each melee weapon attack: Martial Focus and the Bonus Action; one attack roll against every creature in a 30-by-5-foot line, the weapon's normal damage to each hit, no Exploits, Mastery or riders (combat/ext/needle_vacuum.py).

TAL_FORCE_IMMOVABLE_ANCHOR.why: A willing creature (you or an ally) within 5 feet of yourself or one of your Pressure Anchors has Advantage on saves against forced movement and falling Prone, a Shove's included (combat/ext/force.py, the save hook).

TAL_FORCE_KINETIC_RESERVOIR.why: When Counterpressure reduces damage, that much pressure (up to 5 x CL) is stored until the end of your next turn; the next Impact, Shockwave, Ground-Answering Palm or Returning Impact that damages a creature adds all of it as Force damage to one damaged target (combat/ext/force.py).

TAL_FORCE_RECOIL_WARD.why: When Counterpressure reduces damage dealt by a creature within 30 feet of the protected target you may pay 1 more CP: it makes a Strength save or is pushed 5 feet directly away from the protected target, within your Force Limit (combat/ext/force.py).

TAL_FORCE_MERIDIAN_OF_IMPACT.label: Meridian of Impact
TAL_FORCE_MERIDIAN_OF_IMPACT.why: 'Objects, structures, and Barriers along the route take one additional damage die': every map object in the line takes the technique's damage roll and one more of its damage dice (combat/ext/objects.py).

TAL_SHADOW_SHADOWLESS_REVERSAL.why: When a hit lands on you: your Reaction and 5 CP (once per round) leave a false silhouette and Shadow Step you (up to half your Speed) out of the attack's reach -- the attack misses; the silhouette snares the first creature entering its space or starting its turn there (Dexterity save: Restrained, or Speed -10 feet) until the start of your next turn (combat/ext/shadow.py, the hit_response hook).

TAL_SHADOW_SHADOW_EXCHANGE.why: When you or an ally within 60 feet is hit: your Reaction and 4 CP teleport it up to 20 feet out of the attack's reach -- the attack misses (combat/ext/shadow.py, the hit_response hook).

TAL_SHADOW_LONG_ROAD_BETWEEN_LANTERNS.why: The action "Long Road Between Lanterns" (Action, 5 CP): from one of your Shadow Anchors (you within 5 feet of it) to within 5 feet of another, with up to your Proficiency Bonus of willing allies within 5 feet of the start (combat/ext/shadow.py).

tianxia.talent.destruction.hammer_throug.why: Owned Hammer collision adds one Destruction Die, not the CL-scaled blast pool. Newly sealed flag; old row behavior retained.

tianxia.talent.destruction.ruinous_inter.why: Ruinous Interruption's ownership, read from this fight's own row by combat/ext/destruction_blast.py. An ownership marker only: keeps_compiling leaves the talent's own typing exactly as it was.

tianxia.talent.destruction.break_the_gua.why: Break the Guard's ownership, read from this fight's own row by combat/ext/destruction_blast.py. An ownership marker only: keeps_compiling leaves the talent's own typing exactly as it was.

tianxia.talent.destruction.ashen_denial.why: Withering Break: the damaged creature cannot gain Temporary HP until the start of your next turn and loses the Temporary HP it has before the damage (combat/ext/destruction_blast.py).

tianxia.talent.destruction.calamity_chai.why: When your Destructive Blast drops a creature to 0 Hit Points you may spend 1 CP: one creature within 10 feet takes one Destruction Die of the blast's type; once per release (combat/ext/destruction_blast.py).

tianxia.talent.destruction.catastrophe_e.why: Once per turn when Deepen the Calamity is paid for a Blast Shape augment's release, 1 CP of the augment comes back (combat/ext/destruction_blast.py).

tianxia.talent.destruction.heaven_cracki.why: A toggle: the next Deepened blast pays 2 CP more and one creature that failed its save against it loses Reactions and has its Speed halved until the start of your next turn; once per fight (combat/ext/destruction_blast.py).

tianxia.talent.destruction.ruin_that_rem.why: When your Destructive Blast damages a creature you may pay 2 CP for a Ruin Trace (1 minute, one per creature); the next blast that damages it consumes the trace for two more Destruction Dice (combat/ext/destruction_blast.py).

TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_IMPROVISED_MASTER.why: A Tap Finish spent after an improvised-weapon hit during the caper deals 1d6 + Proficiency Bonus (combat/ext/monkey.py).

TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_STAFF_OF_THE_LAUGHING_S.why: Once per turn on a staff hit while Capering Footwork is active, a Monkey Link may be spent on one Staff Finish: Sweeping Tail (push 10 feet), Crooked Branch (pull 10 feet), Peach-Stealing Tap (no Reactions), Upside-Down Strike (move 10 feet) (combat/ext/monkey.py).

covers: Structures and unattended objects take double damage.
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_HEAVEN_UPROOTING_STAFF.label: Heaven-Uprooting Staff
TAL_MONKEY_STYLE_HEAVEN_UPROOTING_STAFF.why: 'Structures and unattended objects take double damage': every such map object in the area takes the technique's damage roll, doubled once (combat/ext/objects.py).

tianxia.talent.disease.infection_of_the_.why: When a creature bearing at least two of your Contagion Tokens spends CP, your Reaction spends one of those tokens: a Constitution save -- no CP regained and Disadvantage on concentration saves until the start of your next turn, or no CP regained until the start of its next turn (combat/ext/disease.py).

tianxia.talent.disease.spreading_infecti.why: When a creature bearing your Contagion Tokens starts its turn within 10 feet of another creature: your Reaction and 2 CP, once per round, make the nearest hostile one save or gain a token (combat/ext/disease.py).

tianxia.talent.poison.virulent_presence.why: While Venom-Sovereign Incarnation is active, an enemy starting its turn within 20 feet of you makes a Constitution save; on a failure the chosen option (a standing pick: 4d8 Poison or Acid, Poisoned, no Reactions, or healing halved until the start of its next turn), on a success half of the 4d8 when damage was chosen (combat/ext/poison.py).

TAL_FENCING_THE_ONE_OPENING_BENEATH_HEAV.why: Each melee weapon attack gets the variant '<weapon> attack: The One Opening Beneath Heaven' (Martial Focus, once per fight): move up to your Speed toward a creature without provoking, then one attack with Advantage and no Weapon Mastery; a hit adds twelve rolls of the weapon's damage die and the three consequences picked from its menu (combat/ext/needle_opening.py).

covers: Unattended fragile objects may also crack or shatter.
tianxia.talent.music.shattering_chorus.label: Shattering Chorus
tianxia.talent.music.shattering_chorus.why: 'Unattended fragile objects may also crack or shatter': every unattended glass, crystal or ice map object in the cone takes the chorus's damage roll (combat/ext/objects.py; 'fragile' in combat/object_rules.py has_tag).

tianxia.talent.radiance.expose_false_for.why: When your Dawnmark lands on an Invisible or Hidden enemy, 1 CP is paid: until that Dawnmark ends the creature's Invisible and Hidden give it no benefit in attacks (combat/ext/radiance.py).
